oauth.hint: Use CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN as a Bearer token with Cloudflare v4 APIs. Scopes are the dot-delimited Cloudflare IDs, such as dns.write or email-routing-rule.write. facts.observed_accounts is a dated /accounts snapshot, not the full consent policy; null means unknown. List /accounts when using the token and choose the target explicitly. Domain registrations and renewals incur charges.
